# Third-party assets

These pinned assets are served locally; the portfolio does not need third-party CDNs at runtime.

- **GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0** — GreenSock, https://gsap.com; distributed under the GSAP Standard License, https://gsap.com/standard-license. Original copyright/license banners are retained in both JavaScript files. Sources: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js.
- **Lenis 1.3.11** — darkroom.engineering, MIT license; see LICENSE-Lenis.txt. Sources: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.11/dist/lenis.min.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.11/dist/lenis.css.
- **Manrope** — Google Fonts Latin variable subset, normal, weights 200–800. SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-Manrope.txt. Source: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/manrope/v23/xn7gYHE41ni1AdIRggexSg.woff2.
- **Instrument Serif** — Google Fonts Latin subsets, normal and italic, weight 400. SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-Instrument-Serif.txt. Sources: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjg.woff2 and https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizHRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zAjjH7M.woff2.

Downloaded October 30, 2026. Font filenames are shortened locally for clarity. JavaScript source-map comments refer to optional development maps, which are not needed to run the site.
